title: Morning Prayer Before You Worry About Money Today (Matthew 6:11)
description:
A morning prayer before you start your day, for when you are worried about money. It is built on one line Jesus taught in Matthew 6:11: Give us this day our daily bread.

If the bills had you doing math before your feet hit the floor, start here. God feeds the birds, and He knows what you need. He gave Israel manna one day at a time, kept a widow's barrel from running out, and did not spare His own Son. Ten minutes of Scripture, then we pray and trust Him for today.

"Give us this day our daily bread." Matthew 6:11 (KJV)

0:00 Before your feet hit the floor
1:11 God cares about the small things (Matthew 6:26)
2:11 Who really pays you (Deuteronomy 8:18)
3:45 Manna, one day at a time (Exodus 16)
4:55 When savings become your trust (Luke 12:20)
6:05 The widow's barrel that did not run out (1 Kings 17)
7:13 God will provide himself a lamb (Genesis 22:8)
8:37 Morning prayer for daily bread

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Matthew 6:9-11, Matthew 6:26, 1 Peter 5:7, Deuteronomy 8:17-18, Acts 17:25, Psalm 104:14, Exodus 16:4, Matthew 6:34, Luke 12:20, 1 Timothy 6:17, 1 Kings 17:14, Psalm 37:25, Genesis 22:8, Romans 8:32, John 6:35, Psalm 68:19.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
